target: acceptance 2 — the check reports and never rewrites. Consolidation is a deliberate action, never a side effect of looking.
cmd: cp "$FIXTURES/learnings/over.md" t.md; a=$(cksum < t.md); o=$("$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/learnings.sh" check t.md 2>&1); rc=$?; b=$(cksum < t.md); [ "$a" = "$b" ] && s=1 || s=0; ran=$(printf "%s" "$o"|grep -ci "over\|cap\|line"); printf '{"unchanged":%s,"ranProperly":%s,"rc":%s}' "$s" "$ran" "$rc"
